bg-34-01.hint: I wash my hands cleanly before eating meals.

bg-34-01.q: State that your hobby is watching movies. Use 취미 + topic particle -은/는, and 영화 보다 nominalized with -기 + copula -예요.
bg-34-01.why: Hobbies and activities are nominalized with -기: 영화 보기예요.

steps.en: Before eating, I wash my hands.
Before meals, I always wash my hands cleanly.

ko: 제 취미는 주말마다 조용한 카페에서 책 읽기예요.
음악을 들으면서 책을 읽으면 마음이 편안해져요.
책 읽기가 끝나면 친구를 만나서 산책하러 가요.
en: My hobby is reading books at a quiet cafe every weekend.
When I read books while listening to music, my mind becomes comfortable.
When book reading ends, I go to take a walk with a friend.

bg-34-01.q: What is the writer's hobby on weekends?
options: Reading books at a quiet cafe
bg-34-01.why: The text states '제 취미는 주말마다 조용한 카페에서 책 읽기예요'.

bg-34-01.q: What does the writer do after finishing reading?
options: Goes to take a walk with a friend
bg-34-01.why: The text says '친구를 만나서 산책하러 가요'.

items: I can turn verbs into dynamic action nouns using -기.
I can use the -기 전에 pattern to talk about actions done beforehand.

bg-34-02.hint: I received great help from a friend.
bg-34-02.why: Noun derived from 돕다 with -(으)ㅁ is 도움: 도움을 받았어요.

bg-34-02.q: State that you received great help from a friend when times were difficult. Use 친구 + source particle -한테서, noun 도움 + object particle -을/를, and 받다 in the past tense (-았/었어요).
bg-34-02.sample: 어려울 때 친구한테서 큰 도움을 받았어요.
bg-34-02.why: 도움 is the established nominal form from 돕다 (ㅂ irregular).

steps.en: I received help from a friend.
When times were tough, I received warm help from a close friend.

ko: 처음 한국에 왔을 때 한국말을 잘 못해서 많이 당황했어요.
그때 같은 반 친구가 한국 생활에 대해 많은 도움을 주었어요.
그 친구 덕분에 서로 깊은 믿음을 쌓고 좋은 친구가 되었어요.
en: When I first came to Korea, I was very confused because I couldn't speak Korean well.
At that time, a classmate gave me a lot of help regarding life in Korea.
Thanks to that friend, we built deep trust with each other and became good friends.

bg-34-02.q: Why was the writer confused when first arriving in Korea?
options: Because they couldn't speak Korean well
Because the weather was too cold
bg-34-02.why: The text says '한국말을 잘 못해서 많이 당황했어요'.

bg-34-02.q: What did the writer and friend build together?
bg-34-02.why: The passage mentions '서로 깊은 믿음을 쌓고'.

items: I can recognize and form established core nouns with -(으)ㅁ (e.g., 잠, 꿈, 믿음, 도움).
I can understand concise status notes on official forms (있음/없음).

bg-34-03.hint: I practice listening and reading together every day.

bg-34-03.q: State that you study listening and speaking for the Korean exam. Use 듣다 nominalized with -기 + connective -와, and 말하다 with -기 + object particle -를.
bg-34-03.sample: 한국어 시험을 위해 듣기와 말하기를 공부해요.
bg-34-03.why: Verbs nominalize to skill names with -기: 듣기와 말하기.

bg-34-03.q: Fix the misspelled formal check-box ending on an official form.
bg-34-03.hint: The standard Korean ending is -(으)ㅁ, not -슴: 있음 / 없음.
bg-34-03.why: Formal written notes and forms use -(으)ㅁ: 있음 / 없음 (not 있슴 / 없슴).

steps.en: I practice listening and reading every day.
Every morning, I practice listening and reading diligently.

ko: 한국어 능력 시험을 준비하면서 매일 듣기와 읽기 문제를 풀어요.
처음에는 어려웠지만 선생님의 도움으로 실력이 많이 늘었어요.
노력하면 좋은 성적을 받을 수 있다는 믿음이 생겼어요.
en: While preparing for the Korean proficiency test, I solve listening and reading questions every day.
At first it was difficult, but thanks to teacher's help, my skills improved a lot.
I developed the belief that if I put in effort, I can get good grades.

bg-34-03.q: What test is the writer preparing for?
bg-34-03.why: The text states '한국어 능력 시험을 준비하면서'.

bg-34-03.q: Whose help made the writer's skills improve?
bg-34-03.why: The text says '선생님의 도움으로 실력이 많이 늘었어요'.

items: I can properly attach -기 to verb stems without sound changes for skill names.
I can apply the batchim rules for -(으)ㅁ, including irregular verbs like 돕다 (도움) and 살다 (삶).

items.ex: 이 동화책은 글자가 커서 읽기 쉬워요.
선생님의 따뜻한 조언이 큰 도움이 되었어요.

bg-34-04.hint: Please wash your hands cleanly before eating meals.
bg-34-04.why: The fixed pattern for 'before doing' is always -기 전에: 식사하기 전에.

bg-34-04.q: State that a book is easy to read because its content is simple. Use verb 읽다 + nominalizer -기 and 쉽다 (ㅂ irregular) in the polite present (-아요/어요).
bg-34-04.sample: 이 책은 내용이 쉬워서 읽기 쉬워요.
bg-34-04.why: The pattern 'easy to do' uses -기 쉽다: 읽기 쉬워요.

bg-34-04.q: Fix the improper nominalization used in a hobby description.
bg-34-04.hint: Hobbies and ongoing activities use dynamic -기: 영화 보기예요.
bg-34-04.why: Activity and hobby nominalization takes -기: 영화 보기예요 (not 영화 봄).

a.d: Used in active grammatical patterns (-기 전에, -기 시작하다, -기 쉽다) and to name hobbies/activities.
ex: 밥 먹**기** 전에 손을 씻어요. / Wash hands before eating.

b.d: Creates established standalone nouns (꿈, 잠, 도움, 믿음) and concise factual entries on forms (있음/없음).
ex: 친구의 따뜻한 도**움**을 받았어요. / I received a friend's warm help.

bg-34-04.tip: Use -기 for processes and fixed patterns; use -(으)ㅁ for solidified abstract nouns and written notes.

steps.en: This Korean storybook is easy to read.
This storybook with lots of pictures is easy to read even for beginners.

ko: 한국어 공부를 시작하기 전에는 한글이 너무 어렵게 느껴졌어요.
하지만 그림이 많은 쉬운 동화책을 골라 읽기 시작하면서 흥미가 생겼어요.
선생님의 큰 도움 덕분에 이제는 한국어로 짧은 일기도 쓸 수 있어요.
en: Before starting to study Korean, Hangul felt too difficult.
However, picking and beginning to read easy storybooks with lots of pictures, interest developed.
Thanks to teacher's great help, I can now even write short diaries in Korean.

bg-34-04.q: How did Hangul feel before starting study?
bg-34-04.why: The text says '공부를 시작하기 전에는 한글이 너무 어렵게 느껴졌어요'.

bg-34-04.q: What can the writer write in Korean now?
bg-34-04.why: The text states '한국어로 짧은 일기도 쓸 수 있어요'.

items: I can select -기 for dynamic activities, hobbies, and fixed patterns (-기 전에, -기 쉽다).
I can use -(으)ㅁ for permanent nouns (도움, 믿음) and concise documentary notes.
